title: Identification and Estimation of Optimal Continuous Treatment Effects
abstract: arXiv:2609.19031v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating continuous treatment effects is hard because average-derivative estimators rely on an ill-posed conditional-density score. Recent work makes a bounded outcome weight the primitive, characterizing a class of weighted average derivative effects without density estimation. In this paper, we develop the identification and estimation theory for the optimally efficient estimands of this class under homoskedasticity and heteroskedasticity. On identification, we show that these estimands relax standard conditions, remaining valid at sharp boundaries and at interior treatment deserts that the strict overlap and density-smoothness conditions of classical theory rule out. On estimation, we derive the efficient influence function, and develop Debiased Machine Learning estimators.

translated_title: 最优连续处理效应的识别与估计
translated_abstract: 估计连续处理效应十分困难，因为平均导数估计量依赖于一个不适定（病态）的条件密度得分。近期的研究将有界的结果权重作为基本要素，刻画了一类无需密度估计的加权平均导数效应。本文在同方差和异方差条件下，为该类中效率最优的估计对象发展了识别与估计理论。在识别方面，我们证明这些估计对象放松了标准条件，在经典理论中严格的重叠条件和密度光滑性条件所排除的尖锐边界以及内部处理空白区域仍然有效。在估计方面，我们推导了有效影响函数，并发展了去偏机器学习估计量。
tldr: 本文为最优连续处理效应建立了识别与估计理论，所提出的估计对象在尖锐边界和处理空白区域仍然有效，并给出了相应的有效影响函数和去偏机器学习估计量。
en_tdlr: This paper develops identification and estimation theory for optimally efficient continuous treatment effect estimands that remain valid at sharp boundaries and interior treatment deserts, deriving efficient influence functions and debiased machine learning estimators.
